tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Use this tool when you need Zain Ahmed's verified engineer profile, biography, 5x multi-cloud credentials, operating principles, or contact links. Returns structured profile metadata scoped to the requested section.

tools.name: get_about
tools.description: Use this tool when you need Zain Ahmed's engineering philosophy, personal letter, architectural story, or core operational tenets. Returns structured narrative and principle records for the selected section.

tools.name: get_skills
tools.description: Use this tool when inspecting Zain Ahmed's categorized technology stack across Multi-Cloud, Kubernetes, Infrastructure as Code, DevSecOps, Observability, and Agentic AI. Returns a dictionary of skill categories and tool lists.

tools.name: get_certifications
tools.description: Use this tool when verifying Zain Ahmed's 5x active multi-cloud certifications across AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI, and HashiCorp. Returns certification titles, issuing institutions, credential IDs, and Credly verification URLs.

tools.name: get_projects
tools.description: Use this tool when listing or filtering verified enterprise production case studies by domain category or technology stack. Returns a paginated list of system blueprints, tech stacks, and business metrics.

tools.name: get_project_by_slug
tools.description: Use this tool when retrieving the complete technical deep-dive for a single case study identified by its slug. Returns the full project record including architecture details, verified metrics, and tech stack.

tools.name: get_articles
tools.description: Use this tool when browsing or filtering published architectural blueprints, SOC 2 compliance guides, and Kubernetes SRE articles by category or tag. Returns a paginated list of article summaries and reading times.

tools.name: get_article_by_slug
tools.description: Use this tool when reading the complete Markdown publication body, frontmatter metadata, and checkpoints of a specific technical article by its slug. Returns the full article object including markdown content.

tools.name: search_knowledge_base
tools.description: Use this tool when performing a full-text keyword search across all portfolio case studies, architecture blueprints, and technical articles. Returns matching project and article summaries with match counts.

tools.name: get_services
tools.description: Use this tool when checking Zain Ahmed's engineering focus areas, advisory scope, and full-time work availability status (no paid engagements). Returns structured capability tier records.

tools.name: calculate_finops_roi
tools.description: Use this tool when modeling estimated monthly and annual cloud cost savings from Karpenter container bin-packing, spot orchestration, and Graviton migration. Returns itemized ROI projections in USD.

tools.name: generate_architecture_manifest
tools.description: Use this tool when generating production-ready Kubernetes YAML or Terraform infrastructure starter manifests for common SRE patterns. Returns the manifest type, suggested filename, and full source code.

tools.name: submit_contact
tools.description: Use this tool when a user explicitly asks to send an engineering question or feedback message to Zain Ahmed. Returns submission status and reference ID; reuse idempotencyKey safely for retries.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_profile" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_certifications · Private data: get_profile, get_about, get_certifications, get_project_by_slug, get_services, submit_contact · Public sink: submit_contact.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_certifications · Private data: get_profile, get_about, get_certifications, get_project_by_slug, get_services, submit_contact · Public sink: submit_contact

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
